references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native shape: a crouching man in a red jacket and a big flared red cape with a high collar, pale face, one hand raised clawing, brown boots.
Shipped The Master (upright robed vampire with a red-gem staff): the vampire crouches in a wide flared scarlet cape with a black lining, no staff, no long robe.

prompt_fields.subject: A vampire seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle: a pale-faced dark-haired man with visible fangs crouching in a predatory lunge, wrapped in a wide flared BRIGHT vivid scarlet-red cape with a high collar, the cape lit with light coral-red highlight planes on every fold and lined only with a thin band of mid crimson (never black), a bright brick-red jacket underneath, one hand raised with curled claws, the other low, mid-grey-brown trousers and tan-brown boots. No staff, no hood. Menacing, predatory and complete, clearly lit.
prompt_fields.contrast: Vampire family, four grades: the vampire is the CROUCHING one in a wide flared scarlet cape with black lining (silhouette: low diagonal lunge, big cape fan, raised claw; hue: scarlet red with black; value: mid-light). The lesser vampire is a plain orange-tunic young man without a cape, the master vampire a tall indigo-cloaked figure, the elder vampire a hooded burgundy robe with violet magic, and the shipped The Master an upright crimson robe with a staff.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures. Calibration from the previous generation of this exact token: it was drawn too dark to read at 48px on a dark floor. This time the creature is clearly LIGHTER and more saturated in every lit plane while the disc stays exactly at the reference lightness: brighter mid-light body colours, strong lighter highlight planes on the upper-left of every fold and limb, no large black or near-black areas anywhere on the body.
prompt_fields.palette: Bright vivid scarlet cape with light coral-red highlights, brick-red jacket, mid crimson lining, luminous pale skin, dark-brown hair, mid-grey-brown trousers, tan boots; the body is mid-light overall and nothing on it is near-black. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.
